title: Fake Transcript Service
scenario: A website offers instant official transcripts for a rush fee.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Fake Transcript Service: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Transcripts should be ordered through the registrar.
